decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own webpage, Product A reflects visible investment and public commitment, so management would likely continue it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.

Product B has lower public visibility than a standalone flagship offer, but as a recent service in a plausible growth area for a German software consultancy, management would still tend to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
Because Product C is newly launched and linked to capabilities that can support broader solution offerings, management is likely to justify the prior investment and keep it on the market for longer.
An open GIS development framework fits a consultancy’s strategic ecosystem and can anchor follow-on projects, so even with limited website prominence management would be inclined to continue it.
Product E shows the strongest explicit launch commitment on the website and is closely tied to the firm’s GeoIT positioning, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
